title: Chagas disease described in full
summary: Carlos Chagas described a previously unknown disease, its parasite Trypanosoma cruzi, its insect vector, hosts, clinical signs and epidemiology, a discovery that holds a unique place in medical history.
why: One person mapped an entire disease cycle.

notes.problem: 'Uniquely complete discovery' not in source; source: 'holds a unique place in the history of medicine'.

unsung.contribution: Described a new infectious disease together with its pathogen, vector, host, clinical signs and epidemiology.
unsung.recognition: Nominated for the Nobel Prize in 1913 and 1921, he never received it.
